e2e.overall_line: A Conditional Use Authorization is needed (changing the conditions of an earlier approval). A Conditional Use Authorization is needed if the floor area is from 2,000 to 3,999 square feet and either the space was last used as another use (not a Bar, a Restaurant, a Limited Restaurant, Nighttime Entertainment, a retail use or a laundromat), or the floor area grows, or storefronts are merged (use size). Zoning does not permit the concept if the floor area is 4,000 square feet or more (use size). Of the 3 approvals this concept needs: 1 further review (zoning and use), 1 insufficient information (building permit and change of use), 1 allowed (health permit).
e2e.entitlement_path: Conditional Use Authorization (Planning Code § 303); Health permit to operate
